tyler (eng-runtime): quick sync: vuln sweep found two libs with late fixes. proposing quick base-image rebuild and cosign signing. no active exploits but want to close the window.

ana (eng-security): which libs and CVEs? I need SBOM diffs and the patch commits before we sign. Also want attestation retention of 13 months and audit logs tied to the KMS key id.

tyler (eng-runtime): openSSL-lib 1.1.2 -> 1.1.2a (CVE-2026-3021), zlib patch (CVE-2026-3077). CI already built artifacts, not signed.

chetan (eng-infra): We can create a customer-managed KMS key alias for this rebuild: alias/rebuild-3901-temp and grant infra-builds role kms:Sign + kms:GetPublicKey. ETA ~20m. Will also enable CloudTrail data events for ECR/S3 to capture attestations.

ana (eng-security): RBAC: only infra-builds SA + two SRE approvers should be able to invoke the promotion job. Add a RoleBinding to the `attest` ns so the controller can read attestations.

chetan (eng-infra): kubectl snippet ready:

```
kubectl create rolebinding rebuild-attest-reader -n attest --role=attest-reader --serviceaccount=infra:build-controller
```

signing-bot: artifact uploaded: https://artifacts.internal.redwood/base-v4/3901230000 (unsigned)

mei (oncall): rollout plan? I can do canary windows. Recommend 5% -> 20% in 1.5h -> gradual. Rollback = route back to base-v3 and revoke new tag if needed.

tyler (eng-runtime): CI changes: add cosign sign step and attest with SBOM + commit SHA. example:

```
cosign sign --key ksm://alias/rebuild-3901-temp registry.redwood/base-v4:sha
cosign attest --predicate sbom.json --key ksm://alias/rebuild-3901-temp registry.redwood/base-v4:sha
aws s3 cp sbom.json s3://attest-redwood/base-v4/3901230000/
```

ana (eng-security): Ensure the attestation predicate includes git SHA, changelog, and SBOM hash. I'll open a short approval ticket for the two approvers. Also we need SIEM to preserve CloudTrail events for 13 months; chetan please create ticket.

chetan (eng-infra): done. Key created: arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/REBUILD_3901. Applied IAM policy and rolebinding.

tyler (eng-runtime): starting 5% canary now. will post p95/p99 and image-pull error rates in ~10m. keep thread for updates only.

mei (oncall): standing by. if crashloops >1% or imagepull errors spike, i'll hit pause and escalate.
